feeds.title: Uni Dzalika
feeds.description: Uni Dzalika has been a part of Fashion & Beauty Blogger Indonesia since 2013. Dza often shares tips on skincare, makeup, reviews of her favorite products, care, and health, as well as secrets about beauty.

feeds.title: Hot Chocolate and Mint
feeds.description: Diana Rikasari is an award-winning blogger, fashion entrepreneur, and book author. She is passionate about fashion and often appreciates art within clothes, shoes, bags, and accessories.

feeds.title: THREAD by ZALORA
feeds.description: THREAD by ZALORA is the largest fashion, beauty, and lifestyle community in Indonesia that can be enjoyed by anyone. Follow to keep up with their latest fashion tips and trends.

feeds.title: VIDA ZENITHA
feeds.description: Hello, I'm Vida Zenitha Sudariasri, S.Pd. I started blogging since 2009. I just write about my personal life (all about what I love and what I hate). As time goes by, now I write on this blog because I love sharing especially about beauty, fashion, and lifestyle.

feeds.title: Beautified Indonesia
feeds.description: Lifestyle & Fashion Trends in Indonesia. Beautified presents classy readings on today's beauty, fashion, and lifestyle tips that are useful for your fashion knowledge and appearance style

feeds.title: DA MAN Magazine
feeds.description: DA MAN is Indonesia's only home-grown men's English language magazine dedicated to offering the best in fashion and lifestyle for the growing market of high-class, fashion forward men in Indonesia and the region. Established in May 2007, DA MAN's exclusive photo shoots and interviews of Hollywood celebrities, international actors and top models, is a testament to how well-respected DA MAN is both in Indonesia and abroad.
